name: Defining and Supporting Psychological Development
subject: Psychology
description: This topic covers how behaviour is categorised as typical or atypical using psychological criteria, how normality and neurotypicality are understood, the nature of neurodiversity, and the roles of mental health professionals and organisations in supporting wellbeing.
